🌆 **Welcome to Chiraq Trenches RolePlay!** 🚦

Make Sure Yall Join The Discord For More Updates

⚠️ **SERVER RULES**

* 🚫 **No Exploiting or Cheating** — Play fair and keep it fun.
* 🤝 **Respect Others** — No harassment, hate speech, or unnecessary toxicity.
* 🔫 **No Excessive Trolling** — Don't ruin the experience for everyone else.
* 🛑 **No Bug Abuse** — Report glitches instead of using them to your advantage.
* 💬 **Listen to Staff** — Follow staff instructions and respect their decisions.
* ❤️ **Have Fun** — Keep the streets active, meet people, and enjoy the game!

📢 **REMEMBER:** Even though this isn't Serious RP, there are still rules. Don't take things too far, respect the community, and keep the roleplay fun for everybody.

🔥 **Enjoy the streets of Chiraq Trenches RolePlay!** 🌴🏙️
